scope: Explicitly selected bounded parsed AC1018 TABLE model, privately captured before public callback and bound to the later same-import reciprocal CRC/ledger source bundle. No output or full graph authority.
implementation: Reader captures a deep TABLE copy and the exact initial CRC-checked frame bytes after block-space/attribute normalization and name resolution, before public callback/journaling. Later post-BLOCKS frame reread must match handle, decoded offset, ordinal, space, encoded class and full body bytes. Published-once and successful whole-read/coverage/failure checks still control delivery.

The preflight admits only a concrete semantic-complete 3x3 model with one text content per cell, 2104 proxy bytes, bounded strings/ranges, no attributes, EED/appdata, reactors, data-storage, native EED write refs or mutable DXF accounting lease. String variants must have canonical owned storage and no dormant layer/color metadata. Count and length bounds precede the deep snapshot; a conservative 256 KiB is charged per retained model against existing aggregate limits.

Adapter deep-copies the private reader model, verifies original parsed proxy provenance is unmodified, applies only the same proxy replay-authorization normalization as its ordinary retained TABLE callback, and compares the unique live TABLE on sealing and every later source query.

Comparison includes generic entity/INSERT/TABLE fields, proxy bytes and provenance, all TABLE row and border overrides and colors, geometry/cells/values, merged ranges and retained raw-handle role codes. Doubles are compared by bit pattern. Previous reciprocal source-only API remains unchanged.

physical_source.result: PASS. Selected TABLE 0x9c model, reciprocal DICTIONARY 0xbb, root, nine child XRECORDs and custom frames are bound in one import. An unrelated HEADER integrity observation remains.
controls: Live TABLE geometry, xdictionary, proxy bytes and replay authorization, each row/border override family, color metadata, range raw handle code and cell/text mutations revoke the entire capability and restore after reset. Duplicate TABLE models are refused.
A forged TABLE callback xdictionary fails the stronger model-bound selection; the earlier source-only reciprocal selection continues to accept the independently authenticated source.
Actual BLOCKS callback exception, same/cross-adapter reentry and reader-snapshot or entity-ticket allocation fault expose no partial capability; same adapter retries successfully.
Strict DXF output of both valid and spoofed bundles refuses while preserving the destination sentinel.

The adapter’s independent legacy 2D INSERT projection is not tracked by this capability: changing it leaves the model source observation valid. No future output gate may rely on this observation alone.

automated_generated_tests.controls: Synthetic model tests cover row/border scalar/flag/color/handle arrays, signed-zero bit equality, proxy bytes, subrecord role, cells, variant deep copy, caller-pointer alias, hidden layer provenance and bounded size/count refusals. Existing generated reader lease and source-bundle tests retain prior CRC, quota and failure coverage.
automated_generated_tests.limits: A generated complete DWG carrying the populated graph is still not available because the output writer correctly refuses it; full model-binding integration and callback/retry controls use the scratch physical source.

limitations: This narrow capture does not prove TABLESTYLE/resources or entire TABLE graph closure, semantic equivalence, native interoperability, or transaction-safe populated output.
The separate LibreCAD-compatible 2D INSERT projection is outside the model capability and can change without invalidation; output must never be authorized on this observation alone.
Only one physical producer/profile and generated model controls were exercised. End-to-end allocation failures are sampled, not swept.
DXF transient parser cursor/accounting fields are not semantic source state; any shared DXF accounting lease is rejected.
